title: Entity Server
text: Serve entities, 2 inputs, 9 outputs, {Service time source} sets the source to specify the service time; {Capacity} sets the capacity of the server, {Service time attribute name} sets the service time source attribute name, {Service time value} sets the value of the service time, {Service time action} sets the service time dt = rand, {Event action} sets the behavior of the entity in certain events, {Permit preemption based on attribute} enables preemption of entities, {Sorting attribute name} sets the name of the attribute used to determine the priority, {Sorting direction} sets the direction of sorting the entities, {Write residual time to attribute} sets the save the residual service time from a preempted entity, {Residual time attribute name} sets the name of the attribute to contain the residual service time of a preempted entity, {Number of entities departed, d} sets the outputs the number of entities that have departed, {Number of entities in block, n} sets the outputs the number of entities present in the block, that are yet, {Pending entity in block, pe} sets the pending entities, {Number of pending entities, np} sets the number of Pending entities, {Average wait, w} sets the outputs the average wait time, {Utilization, util} sets the outputs the average time the server, {Number of entities preempted, p} sets the outputs the number of preempted entities and {Number of entities extracted, ex} sets the number of entities extracted from this. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Capacity
params.values: Specify the capacity of the server 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Service time source
params.values: Choose the source to specify the service time Dialog (default) | Signal port | Attribute | MATLAB action

params.name: Service time attribute name
params.values: Specify service time source attribute name ServiceTime (default) | character vector

params.name: Service time value
params.values: Specify the value of the service time 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Service time action
params.values: Specify service time dt = rand(1,1) (default) | MATLAB code

params.name: Event action
params.values: Specify the behavior of the entity in certain events Entry (default) | Service complete | Exit | Blocked | Preempt

params.name: Permit preemption based on attribute
params.values: Enable preemption of entities off (default) | on

params.name: Sorting attribute name
params.values: Specify the name of the attribute used to determine the priority entity | entitySys.priority | character vector

params.name: Sorting direction
params.values: Choose the direction of sorting the entities Ascending (default) | Descending

params.name: Write residual time to attribute
params.values: Save the residual service time from a preempted entity to an attribute off (default) | on

params.name: Residual time attribute name
params.values: Specify the name of the attribute to contain the residual service time of a preempted entity ResidualTime (default) | character vector

params.name: Number of entities departed, d
params.values: Outputs the number of entities that have departed the block off (default) | on

params.values: Outputs the number of entities present in the block, that are yet to depart off (default) | on

params.name: Number of pending entities, np
params.values: Number of Pending entities off (default) | on

params.name: Average wait, w
params.values: Outputs the average wait time off (default) | on

params.values: Outputs the average time the server is occupied off (default) | on

params.values: Outputs the number of preempted entities off (default) | on
